answer.explanation: CompressionFunction is the only function that fails in this window: most invocations report Duration 3000.00 ms with Status: timeout, and its Init Duration is often 400-700 ms. Its peak memory (about 91-98 MB) stays under the 128 MB limit, so this is not an out-of-memory failure. The other three functions run in roughly 25-240 ms at 256 or 1024 MB. The consistent 3-second cutoff, together with a 128 MB allocation that gives the function little CPU, points to the live memory and timeout settings as the cause. The IaC template is listed as a candidate because it may define those same values.
